CustomField.description: SAP SD Sales Order document number returned by API_SALES_ORDER_SRV after the Order acknowledgment push (ADR-023). Populated by SapSalesOrderService.publishToSap when the SAP push succeeds. Format is SAP's internal SO numbering (10-digit string with leading zeros, e.g. 0090000456). Null = SAP push has not yet succeeded for this Order; populated value = SAP has the SO recorded for fulfillment + billing.
CustomField.label: SAP Sales Order Number
